Title: User registration with valid details
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to /auth/register
2. Fill all required fields with valid data
3. Submit registration form
Expected Result: User is registered successfully and redirected to login or home

Title: User login with valid credentials
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to /auth/login
2. Enter valid email and password
3. Click Login
Expected Result: User is logged in and navigation shows user menu

Title: Login with invalid password
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to /auth/login
2. Enter valid email with wrong password
3. Click Login
Expected Result: Error message is displayed and user remains on login page

Title: Browse products and add to cart
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to homepage
2. Select a product
3. Click Add to Cart
4. Open cart/checkout
Expected Result: Product appears in cart with correct name and quantity

Title: Update cart quantity
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to checkout/cart page
2. Change quantity of cart item
3. Verify line totals update
Expected Result: Cart reflects updated quantity and totals recalculate

Title: Complete checkout with Cash on Delivery
Test Steps:
1. Proceed to checkout
2. Fill billing details
3. Select Cash on Delivery
4. Press Confirm twice to generate invoice
Expected Result: Order is placed and invoice is generated successfully

Title: View invoice in My Invoices
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to My Invoices
2. Locate latest invoice
3. Open invoice details
Expected Result: Invoice is listed with correct order details and invoice number

Title: Profile information verification
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to account profile
2. Review first name last name and email fields
Expected Result: Profile displays registered user information correctly
